about: OptiScaler wiki INI items reviewed for automatic use (RULES.md P1). build_recipes.py attaches each 'promote' item to its wiki entry; packaging/compat.py writes it only for a strong match (launcher ID, or exe name with title or folder), only where every condition of the item holds for the install, only where OptiScaler.ini still says auto, and never where an OptiScaler quirk sets the key for the exe. 'reject' items stay shown with their condition. First pass: the ten INI items the 2026-10-19 assessment classed auto-now (build/compat-20261019/wiki/assessment.json).
reviewer: agent review for the maintainers, 2026-10-19; to be confirmed by a maintainer before 1.0
